title: docs(releases): releases-maintenance.md still documents the objectui pin flow (bump-objectui.sh, .objectui-sha, the changeset digest) that #25745 deleted
body:
Filing gate ③: a finding from the #25736 card thread's reading (6412534624), confirmed by the devx seat (seat post #6023, session `session_01LKHDniRQSWjRJyDtacwpEd`). This is not a claim; the claim follows separately.

**Business reason:** `docs/releases-maintenance.md` is the release runbook. It still tells a maintainer to run `scripts/bump-objectui.sh` and to keep `.objectui-sha` current, and it describes the pin-currency gate and the objectui changeset digest as live. #25745 (`2a61f08093`, the ui-merge release lane, "the objectui pin is deleted") deleted all of it. Anyone cutting 18.2.0 from this page would follow steps that no longer exist.

**Reader who acts:** `domain:devx`. This is release tooling docs. One docs-only PR.

## Measured (`origin/main`, 2026-10-26)

- `git grep -n -E "bump-objectui|\.objectui-sha|objectui-changeset-digest|objectui-range" origin/main -- docs/releases-maintenance.md` finds 25 lines, among them ~L38–100 (the "objectui pin" section: bump script usage, "the pin must be a commit on objectui main", the unreadable-pin refusal) and ~L200–255.
- `scripts/bump-objectui.sh`, `scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs`, `scripts/objectui-range.mjs` and `.objectui-sha` are all absent on `origin/main`.

## Wanted

- Rewrite or remove the pin-flow sections of `docs/releases-maintenance.md` so the runbook describes today's flow. `@object-ui` is in the fixed release group, and `@objectstack/console` builds from `ui/apps/console` (#25745). Link #25745 / #25711 for the history instead of retelling it.
- Grep the page for every other sentence that depends on the pin, such as Console Pin Gate and pin currency, and fix those too.

## Not in scope (listed, not edited here)

- `.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md` (3 lines) is a governed skills surface, so it needs contract review. It is left for a skills-lane card.
- Workflow comments that still mention `.objectui-sha` (`lint.yml:998`, `:1015`, `release.yml:1846`, `scheduled-full-run-card.yml:56`) are Tier H and comments only. They are left for the ui-merge retirement (#25712) or a later Tier H sweep.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` (≈60 lines) are ledgers. Their edits ride the 18.2.0 sweep cards (#25835–#25849, on hold).
- `docs/audits/**` is historical record and stays as written.
